result.brief: 提出 RehearsalWorld：先用 3D 交互预演（点流先验+接触/抓取约束）得到物理一致轨迹，再以其几何投影作为时序条件微调视频生成器，实现可编辑的机器人世界模型。
result.reason: Action-conditioned robot world model with 3D interaction rehearsal conditioning a video generator; main contribution is embodied world modeling/planning, with 3D motion prior and projection conditioning.
